# Atlas

Atlas keeps field notes in sync between devices. See the [plan](docs/plan.md) and the [spec](docs/spec.md).

## Getting started

1. Install the service.
2. Set `API_KEY=sk-live-123456` in your shell.
3. Run `atlas sync`.

## Contributing

Open an issue first. Keep changes small.
